rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you get something or detect a signal, such as a present or a message.

example.english: I receive your messages every day.
example.traditional: 我每日都收到你嘅短訊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 sau1 dou3 nei5 ge3 dyun2 seon3

rows.note: Use this for receiving or looking after guests in your home or company, rather than simply getting something.

example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ngo5 fu6 zaak3 ziu1 fu1 di1 haak3

rows.note: Use this when someone incurs or sustains an injury.

example.english: They receive an injury while running.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 paau2 bou6 go2 zan6 sau6 soeng1 laa3
